size.value: 35x45mm (3.5x4.5cm) for biometric passport photo capture; an alternate 5x5cm (50x50mm) format is used for non-biometric travel documents issued at Israeli missions abroad

head_height.value: Face height from chin to hairline: 32mm to 36mm

validity.value: Photo must be taken within the last 3 months

glasses_policy.value: Glasses are not permitted (no exception stated other than documented medical necessity)

ears_visibility.value: Both ears must be visible; hair must be tucked behind the ears

face_visibility.value: Facial features must be fully visible, including the eyebrows

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, closed mouth, no smiling

headwear_policy.value: No hat or head covering permitted, unless worn for religious reasons

glasses.en: Glasses are not permitted, except for documented medical necessity.
glasses.ko: 의학적 필요성이 증빙된 경우를 제외하고 안경 착용이 불가하다.
glasses.ja: 医学的必要性が証明される場合を除き、眼鏡の着用は不可。

ears.en: Both ears must be visible; hair must be tucked behind the ears.
ears.ko: 양쪽 귀가 모두 보여야 하며, 머리카락은 귀 뒤로 넘겨야 한다.
ears.ja: 両耳がはっきり見える必要があり、髪は耳の後ろにまとめること。

face_visibility.en: Facial features must be fully visible, including the eyebrows.
face_visibility.ko: 눈썹을 포함한 모든 얼굴 특징이 완전히 보여야 한다.
face_visibility.ja: 眉を含むすべての顔の特徴がはっきり見える必要がある。

expression.en: Neutral expression with a closed mouth; no smiling.
expression.ko: 입을 다문 중립적인 표정을 지어야 하며, 미소는 금지된다.
expression.ja: 口を閉じた中立的な表情であること。微笑みは禁止。

headwear.en: No hat or head covering is permitted, unless worn for religious reasons.
headwear.ko: 종교적 사유로 착용하는 경우를 제외하고 모자나 머리가리개 착용이 불가하다.
headwear.ja: 宗教上の理由で着用する場合を除き、帽子や頭を覆うものの着用は不可。

cross_verification.note_en: Direct WebFetch access to gov.il and embassies.gov.il was blocked (403/connection reset) on every attempt during this research pass; the figures above are corroborated by web-search indexing that directly surfaced the specific gov.il/embassies.gov.il URLs (genuine Israeli government domains, not third-party aggregators) with consistent, repeated figures across multiple independent queries -- size, background, head height, ear/eyebrow visibility, glasses, expression, and headwear all recurred identically. DB size (3.5x4.5cm) and head_height (3.2-3.6cm) both match the biometric-capture figures found (35x45mm / 32-36mm) almost exactly -- no conflict, strong confirmation. A secondary 5x5cm format for overseas non-biometric travel documents was also consistently found but is noted as an alternate track, not a conflict, since DB's value matches the primary biometric format.
